```{=html}
<style>
.w014 { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w014 .w014-rows { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w014 .w014-row {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 5px 8px;
  border: 2px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
}
.w014 .w014-row.w014-right { border-color: #2e7d32; }
.w014 .w014-row.w014-wrong { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w014 .w014-st { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.w014 .w014-tf {
  flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); font-weight: 600;
}
.w014 .w014-tf.w014-sel { border-color: #d81e2e; outline: 2px solid #d81e2e; outline-offset: 1px; }
.w014 .w014-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w014 button.w014-btn {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w014 .w014-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w014 .w014-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w014 .w014-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w014 .w014-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w014 .w014-expl {
  font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32;
  padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px;
}
</style>
<div class="w014 iw" id="w014">
  <div class="w014-rows" aria-label="statements to judge"></div>
  <div class="w014-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w014-btn w014-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w014-btn w014-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w014-btn w014-sol iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w014-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w014-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w014-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    No system was breached and no password was stolen in the Strava case: the failure was a governance decision, aggregated anonymous data still revealed sensitive facts, and confidentiality proved contextual. An IaaS tenant, moreover, cannot examine the provider’s underlying systems, and sudden instance growth is hard to tell apart from a denial-of-service attack. See <a href="#exm-strava">the Strava heat-map example</a> in <a href="#sec-01-why-cloud-security">the section on why cloud security</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w014');
  const rowsBox = root.querySelector('.w014-rows');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w014-msg');
  const STATEMENTS = [
    ['In the Strava case, an attacker breached a system and stole passwords.', 'f'],
    ['Aggregated, anonymised data can still reveal sensitive facts.', 't'],
    ['The Strava failure was a governance decision rather than a technical one.', 't'],
    ['Confidentiality is contextual: the same running route can be harmless in a city park and sensitive at a military installation.', 't'],
    ['An IaaS tenant can examine and configure the provider’s underlying systems.', 'f'],
    ['A sudden growth of running instances can be hard to tell apart from a denial-of-service attack.', 't']
  ];
  function clearMarks() {
    [...rowsBox.children].forEach(r => r.classList.remove('w014-right', 'w014-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w014-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function makeRow(text, answer) {
    const row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'w014-row';
    row.dataset.a = answer;
    const st = document.createElement('div');
    st.className = 'w014-st'; st.textContent = text;
    row.appendChild(st);
    ['t', 'f'].forEach(v => {
      const b = document.createElement('button');
      b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'w014-tf'; b.dataset.v = v;
      b.textContent = v === 't' ? 'True' : 'False';
      b.addEventListener('click', () => {
        row.querySelectorAll('.w014-tf').forEach(x => x.classList.remove('w014-sel'));
        b.classList.add('w014-sel');
        clearMarks();
      });
      row.appendChild(b);
    });
    return row;
  }
  root.querySelector('.w014-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, wrong = 0, open = 0;
    [...rowsBox.children].forEach(row => {
      row.classList.remove('w014-right', 'w014-wrong');
      const sel = row.querySelector('.w014-tf.w014-sel');
      if (!sel) { open++; return; }
      if (sel.dataset.v === row.dataset.a) { row.classList.add('w014-right'); right++; }
      else { row.classList.add('w014-wrong'); wrong++; }
    });
    if (right === STATEMENTS.length) { msg.textContent = '✓ All correct - no breach is needed for a security failure.'; msg.className = 'w014-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else if (open > 0 && wrong === 0) { msg.textContent = 'Keep going - ' + open + ' statement(s) not yet judged.'; msg.className = 'w014-msg iw-msg'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet - the red statements are judged wrongly' + (open ? ', and ' + open + ' still open' : '') + '.'; msg.className = 'w014-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w014-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    rowsBox.querySelectorAll('.w014-tf').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('w014-sel'));
    clearMarks();
    root.querySelector('.w014-expl').hidden = true;
  });
  root.querySelector('.w014-sol').addEventListener('click', () => {
    [...rowsBox.children].forEach(row => {
      row.classList.remove('w014-right', 'w014-wrong');
      row.querySelectorAll('.w014-tf').forEach(b => {
        b.classList.toggle('w014-sel', b.dataset.v === row.dataset.a);
      });
      row.classList.add('w014-right');
    });
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown - reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w014-msg iw-msg ok';
    root.querySelector('.w014-expl').hidden = false;
  });
  STATEMENTS.forEach(s => rowsBox.appendChild(makeRow(s[0], s[1])));
})();
</script>
```
